source_snapshot.scope: Selected local fixtures only; source hashes and byte spans are authoritative.

cases.title: Physical trailing spaces, tabs and disabled endline insertion
prerequisites: LaTeX wrapper for the original; the derived reader check supplies latex_ascii categories and endlinechar=-1.
Read raw bytes: trimming the fixture during import destroys the subject.

observations.claim: The split Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious must join; a trailing tab must still yield a separating space.
The XML contains the joined word and the separate following words; it does not expose token categories or spans.

limits: The reader check excludes documentclass and endlinechar assignment execution.
Endlinechar is captured at physical-line load; its refinement may require an earlier checkpoint than the next token.

staged_experiment.trigger: An earlier applicable reading context becomes known after provisional reading.
staged_experiment.action: Replay from before the affected physical line was loaded; retain the raw whitespace and replace dependent observations.
assertions: Match immediate-context reading token-for-token and preserve source intervals.
Do not apply whitespace normalization to stored token lists or literal regions.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Keep the source and its context obligation; another pass without new evidence changes no status.

cases.title: Mixed physical line endings and included-file boundary
prerequisites: Article/verb support for the original document.
Include the raw newlines-input.tex helper and distinguish EOF from a physical line delimiter.

observations.claim: LF, CRLF, CRCRLF and CR boundaries exercise space versus paragraph production; the included file ends in two CR bytes.

limits: A helper is not an independent root test.
No derived execution check or new native run is claimed for this entry.

staged_experiment.trigger: An input edge or its decoding/reading context is resolved after surrounding source was inspected.
staged_experiment.action: Revisit the include boundary with a fresh input-stack context, invalidating affected paragraph observations.
assertions: Keep parent and child source occurrences distinct.
Compare physical-line events as well as rendered text.
Preserve bytes through import; copying with newline conversion is a changed experiment.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Retain the missing or opaque include and any assumed boundary state.

cases.title: Category changes, aliases and frozen token identity
prerequisites: Local catcode changes, ifx, let and group restoration.
The full document also uses math behavior and a format-private active-prime helper.

observations.claim: Equal categories do not erase character identity; let can copy a character meaning, while changing later source catcodes changes subsequent tokenization.

limits: The derived check manually restores a reader checkpoint and refines context. It is not the proposed dependency scheduler.
Full math-active behavior is outside the derived check.

staged_experiment.trigger: A provisional source read used an incomplete category table.
staged_experiment.action: Restore a checkpoint and publish a revised reading under the context applicable at that position.
assertions: Match a fresh correct-context read.
Previously returned immutable token objects retain their categories and source identity.
Never retokenize a committed macro body when its current context changes.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Mark provisional tokens and their dependent observations as unresolved.

cases.title: Display operations observe current context without replacing token identity
prerequisites: meaning, string, detokenize, expansion control, active characters and local category changes.
The original expansion driver requires t1enc.def for meaning.tex.

observations.claim: The same tester compares string, meaning, meaning-of-string and detokenize for characters, active characters, definitions and undefined names.

limits: Displayed text is one observation; equality of displays does not establish typed meaning equality.
The 533-case assay triage is related evidence, not execution of this fixture.

staged_experiment.trigger: Display context (such as escapechar or a single-character name's category) becomes known.
staged_experiment.action: Recompute dependent display observations from preserved typed meanings.
assertions: Preserve the original semantic descriptor.
Keep display output and a later deliberate rescan as distinct operations.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Retain the typed meaning where known and a separate unresolved display requirement.

cases.title: Meaning-based reconstruction is an executable protocol
prerequisites: protected definitions, nested edef, noexpand, detokenize, string, scantokens, ifx and group restoration.
The original is a plain-format-style root ending in bye.

observations.claim: ifscanable rebuilds a definition from its displayed meaning and tests it with ifx.
The recorded LaTeXML result is 1 for firstoftwo.

limits: Success for firstoftwo is not a universal inverse for meaning.
The definition fragment and eight added observations match the pinned native reference; the original complete document remains unrun. See ../behavioral-atlas.md#pinned-native-program-comparisons.

staged_experiment.trigger: The reconstructed body has an unresolved reading regime or name boundary.
staged_experiment.action: Keep candidate reconstructions separate, resolve source/context constraints, then compare typed meanings and behavior.
assertions: Require semantic comparison in addition to display equality.
Separate a proven source-derived meaning from an assumed reconstruction.
If scantokens intentionally rescans characters, preserve that operation's own context and provenance.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Report ambiguity or failure of reconstruction; do not silently install the best-looking string.

cases.title: Generated names and escapechar-dependent text
prerequisites: csname, string, numeric escapechar state, argument scanning and helper definitions for the full source.
The bounded derived check uses a synthetic T1-cmd name motivated by the assay, not a copied substring of this fixture.

observations.claim: The chomper generates different names with escapechar=-1 and the normal backslash setting.
The target contains Foo/Bar and A Foo/A Bar for the two calls.
A generated name containing nonletters remains one control-sequence token; reading its display as source can split it.

limits: Computed name spelling can intentionally depend on display state; the engine must execute that dependency.
A name inventory cannot uniquely recover all token boundaries from display text.

staged_experiment.trigger: An input to computed-name construction becomes known.
staged_experiment.action: Resolve the name-producing expression in its invocation context and invalidate only dependent name lookups.
assertions: Store the resulting name independently of how a source lexer would spell it.
A missing lookup may be retried after a justified namespace revision, without applying later definitions retroactively.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Keep a computed-name obligation rather than inventing a literal name or binding.

cases.title: Parameter marker and digit assembled across expansion
prerequisites: expanded, expandafter, def, number, signed integer scanning and parameter token recognition.
The bounded Python check supplies an initialized reader context; it does not run the full torture fixture.

observations.claim: A literal parameter marker and expanded digit 1 form the parameter of a newly constructed identity macro.
The displayed ddd meaning has parameter #1 and replacement #1 (XML uses font-converted glyphs for the arrow).

limits: Do not copy the XML's rendered punctuation as native meaning text.
A scanner limited to contiguous source characters cannot cover generated parameter syntax.

staged_experiment.trigger: An expansion producing definition syntax was deferred.
staged_experiment.action: Resume through the shared expansion/scanning machinery with preserved token categories and expansion-frame provenance.
assertions: Create one parameter and one parameter reference, then exercise the resulting macro on an argument.
Checkpoint replay must not install the definition twice or consume following source twice.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Retain the incomplete definition and identify the prerequisite expansion; do not guess arity.

cases.title: Expansion barriers and literal parameter tokens
prerequisites: expanded, noexpand, unexpanded, detokenize, edef, token registers and group-token aliases.

observations.claim: T5.1-T5.9 contrast suppression, nested expansion, token-register insertion and doubled parameter characters.

limits: The commented torture expression is inactive source, not an exercised case.

T5.1-T5.9 now have individual pinned native observations. Python matches seven; T5.7 needs token registers and T5.8 needs opening-group alias handling. See ../behavioral-atlas.md#expanded-list-insertion-implementation.

staged_experiment.trigger: A suspended expansion frame becomes ready after a prerequisite resolves.
staged_experiment.action: Resume with frame-local suppression and parameter context intact.
assertions: Compare with uninterrupted execution at multiple suspension points.
Noexpand suppression must not become a permanent token property.
Separate literal parameter tokens from compiled argument references.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Retain frame state and unconsumed input; do not flatten through a display string.

cases.title: Source-derived expl3 conditional generator
prerequisites: The source's own helper definitions and typed chardefs, plus protected/edef/def, csname, expansion barriers, number, string, detokenize, conditionals and endline/category assignments.
Source comments attribute this extracted/adapted program to expl3 from TeX Live 2019; it is not the current pinned kernel release.

observations.claim: The source creates mytest:NF from helper macros while switching colon categories and treating spaces/tilde specially.
The existing target displays a one-argument generated macro with its conditional body; it does not exercise both branches of that macro.

limits: Executing this reduced source would qualify its mechanisms, not the whole current expl3 release.

Pinned native defined/undefined/relax and helper-redefinition witnesses are captured. Python now derives the matching definition; branch execution reaches the unavailable romannumeral primitive. See ../behavioral-atlas.md#expanded-list-insertion-implementation.
This entry does not authorize a Python intrinsic named after the helper.

staged_experiment.trigger: A helper definition or reading-state prerequisite becomes available.
staged_experiment.action: Derive the computed definition through the same engine; compare uninterrupted and selectively resumed runs.
assertions: Match generated parameter/body descriptors and definition provenance.
Invoke the generated function across branch outcomes, then redefine helpers and check invalidation.
Preserve category differences established at each definition position.
staged_experiment.unresolved: Expose the first actual missing mechanism with its dependency path rather than importing the golden meaning.
